_about: Public-domain Louis Veuillot (1813-1883), the French Ultramontane journalist of L'Univers, in English translation for the Word Hoard: The Life of Our Lord Jesus Christ, tr. Anthony Farley (1878), and Stephanie, tr. Josephine Black (1883), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

veuillot-life-of-our-lord: The Life of Our Lord Jesus Christ, from the seventh French edition, tr. Anthony Farley (New York: Peter F. Collier, 1878)
veuillot-stephanie: Stephanie, tr. Josephine Black (Dublin: M. H. Gill and Son, 1883)

_excluded.veuillot-later: The Liberal Illusion, tr. George Barry O'Toole (post-1929); French editions
